## Summary

What changed, and why? Link a related issue if available.

## Scope

- [ ] Documentation / repository guidance only
- [ ] Prebuilt site release (describe provenance, source revision, and build
      instructions when available; identify missing evidence)

## Validation

List the checks actually performed and their results. For documentation, check
links, Markdown rendering, and consistency with this distribution. For site
releases, use the hosting checklist and distinguish hardware tests from
simulated or inferred behavior. State what was not tested.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves relevant safety and privacy warnings.
- [ ] No secrets, personal lock data, raw captures, or unrelated files are included.
- [ ] Compatibility and validation claims match the evidence provided.
- [ ] Relevant documentation has been updated.
- [ ] I ran `git diff --check` (or `git diff --cached --check` for staged changes).
